comment: Hand-transcribed expected ubus luci.getLEDs decisions for luci-mod-system-config from pinned uhttpd uh_ubus_allowed, leds.js rpc.declare, and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: uh_ubus_allowed requires session.access scope=ubus object=luci function=getLEDs (uhttpd omits scope).
Bounded to leds.js rpc.declare object=luci method=getLEDs at luci b2e0be4b. admin/system/leds depends on luci-mod-system-config. That is the luci-base plugin, not procd system.
Fixture login luci-mod-system-config is write of the existing ACL group in luci-mod-system.json. Write implies read.
luci.getTimezones stays on policy:ubus-luci-gettimezones-v1; this slice does not emit that grant.
getUSBDevices stays unstaffed (no luci-ssl JS call site at b2e0be4b); this slice does not emit that grant.
luci.getUnixtime stays on policy:ubus-luci-getunixtime-v1; this slice does not emit a luci-mod-system-config getUnixtime grant.
luci.getOdhcp6cStats stays on policy:ubus-luci-getodhcp6cstats-v1.
rc.init stays on policy:ubus-rc-init-v1. rc.list stays on policy:ubus-rc-list-v1.
Do not rewrite the luci exec-methods emitter.
Do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant.
Do not invent a luci-mod-status-index-storage login.
Missing SID is JSON-RPC ERROR_PARSE, not the all-zero sentinel.
Unauthenticated is ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed (unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures).
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Do not emit dispatcher, authorization_violation, or path_found.
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers.
luci-mod-system flash.js write sysupgrade/firstboot stay unstaffed.
luci-mod-network diagnostics ping is not this slice.
crontab.js cron reload is not this slice (ubus file.write, not file.exec).
hostapd.del_client / wps_start / wps_cancel / wps_status stay on their hostapd revisions.
Extra keys in the data table still pass uh_ubus_allowed; intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no ubus luci.getLEDs
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed: session.access luci/getLEDs false -> ERROR_ACCESS
do not invent an unauthenticated luci.getLEDs grant
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE
missing SID is not rewritten to 0000... in luci-ssl-25.12

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-system-config is not a stock device login. Existing write fixture grants getLEDs via write-implies-read. leds.js uses rpc.declare object=luci method=getLEDs. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-mod-system.json admin/system/leds depends on luci-mod-system-config
rpcd session.c login_test_permission: write implies read
fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-config list write luci-mod-system-config

cases.note: Extra keys in the data table still pass uh_ubus_allowed. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed matches object/function, not data keys
extra argv is intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC
luci-mod-system-reboot has ubus system.reboot, not luci.getLEDs

cases.note: The list-read flash fixture has ubus file.exec, not luci.getLEDs. ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed. Do not invent a write flash login.
system.js declares luci.getTimezones. That method stays on policy:ubus-luci-gettimezones-v1. This slice does not emit a getTimezones grant.

luci-mod-system-config read grants luci.getUSBDevices. The config fixture matches getUSBDevices at uh_ubus_allowed. luci-ssl JS at b2e0be4b has no rpc.declare for getUSBDevices. This slice does not emit a getUSBDevices grant.
rule_refs: getUSBDevices stays unstaffed (no luci-ssl JS call site at b2e0be4b)

cases.note: system.js declares luci.getUnixtime. That method stays on policy:ubus-luci-getunixtime-v1. This slice does not emit a luci-mod-system-config getUnixtime grant.
The luci-mod-system-config fixture matches rc.init at uh_ubus_allowed. That method stays on policy:ubus-rc-init-v1. This slice does not emit a rc.init grant.
The luci-mod-system-config fixture matches rc.list at uh_ubus_allowed via write-implies-read. That method stays on policy:ubus-rc-list-v1. This slice does not emit a rc.list grant.
Stock root list read/write '*' is intended_access (root-administration), not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package overlay rpcd.config root read/write '*'
